source_url: https://results.texas-election.com/ (Texas Secretary of State official election results; each election’s County.json, field Summary.RV registered / Summary.VC ballots cast). Every statewide election the site holds, 2019–2024, all 254 counties. Primary days add the Democratic and Republican primaries (a voter can vote in only one); statewide totals are the sum of the counties. The July 14, 2020 runoff is left out: in the state’s file 13 counties report more ballots than registered voters.
